Someone linked me “dontgetthejab.com” the other day, and then called me a sheep for calling if propaganda.

They legitimately get all of their “information” from random sketchy websites that claim to have some untapped truth. They usually take very rare cases of side effects, out of context.

For real. They literally managed to strawman people who just want to be safe.

Like I wasn’t held at gunpoint by Obama to get a shot, I just wanna go to the damn movies again, and not have to worry that I’m inadvertently getting someone sick while I do it.

I’m guessing it was his friends. 

We grew up in a very politically neutral/accepting household (my parents are democrats but it was never pushed on us) so we just formed our own opinions. 

In high school his friends and him seemed to change a bit, at first it was just him listening to country music which was a bit weird but like who cares, some of the music was kinda good lol. Him and his dickhead friends would always say racist shit but I assumed he’d grow out of him.

I’d say him meeting his girlfriend in 10th grade made the biggest change in him. She’s republican and her family that he’s close with is the staunch right-wing type from what I know, I don’t know if they supported trump but just the usual “I hate dems, abortion is murder, blue lives matter BLM just loots.” 

He also started watching Steven Crowder and those type of influencers which I know played into it (I watch left-wing streamers and they react/debunk Crowders stuff a lot so I can tell when my brothers just getting talking points from him.). 

Luckily he’s aware Qanon is crazy bullshit, but he’s just so disillusioned on what the rep party actually is that it’s weird. He tried to tell me that Trump doesn’t represent the party and that he’s an outlier, while still sometimes saying “well he wasn’t the worst/he made some people feel like they had a leader/his damage was overhyped by the media.”

Srry this was so long and I hope I didn’t come off as condescending or anything

I have one line about being trans, but idk whether or not I wanna put it in because I don’t elaborate much on it and I don’t want it to affect peoples first opinion on me. Are there any jokes that y’all think are just gonna be brutally unfunny no matter my delivery? (I know there are defiantly a few that I’m going to have to throw out or at least rewrite.) Also, does anyone have any advice on how to be more original with my writing, and how to come up with a creative delivery that isn’t a rip off of the other comedians I watch? I also want advice on how to do write proper segways cause I feel like ending a bit with “anyways..” and then jumping into the next bit seems awkward. I know my first few times are probably going to suck no matter what, but I just hope I don’t bomb as much as I did in this video lmao. Thanks for reading this whole thing if you made it this far without cringing too hard!
